name: list_project_files
description: List files in the Laravel project matching a glob pattern. Use this before generating code to discover existing files, check if a model or migration already exists, or understand the project structure.

pattern.description: Glob pattern relative to the Laravel project root.

includeContent.description: Whether to include the first 10 lines of each file in the response (useful for quick class/namespace inspection). Defaults to false.

useCases: Check if app/Models/Product.php already exists before generating a new one
Find all existing Livewire components to understand naming conventions
Discover all migrations to avoid duplicate table creation
Find all Pest test files to understand test coverage gaps
